moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: His reply to a suggestion to hire the ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang lit up tech and finance communities amid an AI/leadership crisis.

moments.author: Giannis Antetokounmpo
moments.quote: Between-the-legs assist to Klay for 3 — football snap level
moments.why: A jaw‑dropping between‑the‑legs pass in an NBA game had guys buzzing over its absurd vision and flair.

moments.author: Sean Duffy
moments.quote: Yesterday @FAANews issued a nationwide ground stop… safety is always our #1 priority.
moments.why: The Transportation Secretary’s post during a rare nationwide flight grounding became a lightning rod for frustration and memes.

moments.author: Sean Duffy
moments.quote: 70% of telecom lines upgraded … yesterday’s outage proved what we already know: our system works — now let's modernize
moments.why: Duffy doubled down on modernization funding appeals amid skepticism—sparking debate over FAA priorities.

moments.author: Scott Bessent
moments.quote: Nvidia must explain earnings & hire an outsider as CEO amid China & IA chip concerns
moments.why: The Treasury Secretary’s call for new leadership at Nvidia adds serious pressure and credibility to the ongoing scandal.
